pending_commit.commit_message: chromeos-config: Add the platform name property to identity This is needed to distinguish different SKU maps within the same family. Add this property to the schema. Also make the sku-id optional, since not all models have it. These changes bring identity into line with the current master config format. BUG=chromium:796983 TEST=see that the schema validation for reef works (it includes this field) Change-Id: I656b432e3272646ad68f8d793117c0bb32578a36 Signed-off-by: Simon Glass <sjg@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/919243 Reviewed-by: C Shapiro <shapiroc@google.com>

chromeos-config: Support outputting a list of phandle properties A long-standing niggle with the device-tree config is that the phandle property names are hard-coded, rather than being read from the schema. Add a command that works similarly to the target directories feature, adding the information to the config. This can then be read by cros_config at run time. BUG=chromium:796983 TEST=sudo emerge -q --nodeps chromeos-config-tools chromeos-config-host emerge-reef chromeos-firmware-reef fdtdump ~/cosarm/chroot/build/reef/usr/share/chromeos-config/config.dtb See that the schema info is present: phandle-properties = "arc-properties-type", "audio-type", "bcs-type", "power-type", "shares", "single-sku", "touch-type", "whitelabel"; Change-Id: I31429aac08db736c07d05cd465279456fa3c957f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/919244 Commit-Ready: Simon Glass <sjg@chromium.org> Tested-by: Simon Glass <sjg@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: C Shapiro <shapiroc@google.com>

CHROMIUM: pkglist: Add dependency on CONFIG_FS It is currently possible to build PKGLIST into the kernel while CONFIGFS_FS is built as module. Doing so results in builds failures due to missing symbols. To avoid the problem, restrict PKGLIST to be buildable only as module if CONFIGFS_FS is built as module. BUG=b:63876697 TEST=Try to build with and without CONFIG_FS enabled Change-Id: I24c0c2a6a4285a8d33833c7063649ddcd421a2f2 Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/919541 Reviewed-by: Sarthak Kukreti <sarthakkukreti@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: security: export security_path_chown esdfs calls security_path_chown, which is not exported. Attempts to build it as module fail with ERROR: "security_path_chown" [fs/esdfs/esdfs.ko] undefined! Making it boolean would also require making PKGLIST, which it depends on, boolean. Let's export security_path_chown instead. BUG=b:63876697 TEST=compilation, mount esdfs Change-Id: If1d833578c1f2c1f25462d72c6de725147a41563 Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/919542 Reviewed-by: Sarthak Kukreti <sarthakkukreti@chromium.org>

sys-devel/arc-toolchain-n: Stop including libLLVM in the toolchain We do not use the libLLVM coming from Android anymore and so there is no reason to keep including it in arc-toolchain-n. Remove anything related to libLLVM from gather.sh script, so that it is no longer included in toolchain packages. As a consequence, there is no need to manually build anything from local Android sources to deploy a new toolchain. init: unmount bind mounts to /run in /var During startup, /var/run and /var/lock are bind mounted to /run and /run/lock respectively, to support backwards compatibility for accessing /run (tmpfs for runtime data) through /var. Need to unmount them in the shutdown script so that cryptohome can unmount /var successfully during its cleanup.
